Executive Summary
Horizon Research Group has been asked by the Belgian Federal Public Service for Digitalisation to produce a concise policy brief on how national procurement rules could incorporate ethical-AI criteria. The brief must be ready for circulation to the Minister’s cabinet by 20 March.

Section 1 – Context
Belgium’s current public-procurement law (Loi sur les marchés publics 2023) contains no explicit reference to algorithmic decision-making. 1. Competitive neutrality: imposing additional documentation requirements on AI vendors could disadvantage smaller European suppliers.

B. Establish a centralised, but voluntary, ‘sandbox’ review panel within the Digitalisation Service that can issue non-binding opinions within 30 days.
C. Allow contracting authorities to accept vendor self-declarations of compliance provided the vendor also publishes a summary of the model’s performance metrics on a public register.
